All 9 tests now pass. There were two bugs, one in each source file.

1. **`src/bill.js`, off-by-one in `splitBill`.** The leftover-cent check was `i <= leftover`, so one payer too many got an extra cent. With 3 people and 1 leftover cent, that gave `[301, 300, 300]`, which sums to more than the total. I changed it to `i < leftover`.

2. **`src/duration.js`, `parseDuration` was too lenient.** It pulled out any `<digits><unit>` matches and ignored everything else. `"10m and change"` was accepted as 10 minutes, and `"3d"` only failed because it matched nothing. I added a check that the whole string must be one or more `<digits><h|m|s>` groups, and it throws `SyntaxError` otherwise.

I didn't touch the tests.
